description: Read CI state in next.sh on gh 2.45.0. Issue #1567 records the defect.

userStories.title: Read CI state from statusCheckRollup
userStories.description: As an advisor, I want `next.sh` to read CI state on `gh` 2.45.0 so that a `/delegate` run does not stop at `blocked`.
acceptanceCriteria: The test stub exits non-zero with `unknown flag: --json` for `gh pr checks --json`.
A test proves that a failed result and a later passing result of one check do not print `ci-red`.
A test proves that a `CheckRun` and a `StatusContext` both map to each state: pass, skipping, cancel, pending, and fail.
`/delegate` § Waves tells the advisor to wait in a foreground call for worker commits.
userStories.notes: Main checkout, task branch. Executed: grep -c gh pr checks next.sh printed 0; bash -n exit 0; pnpm exec vitest run next.test.mjs exit 0, 74 passed, including the stub rejection, re-run, and mapping cases. Executed: grep finds the foreground wait in Waves item 14. Reasoned: StatusContext has no skipping or cancel state, so it maps to pass, pending, and fail only.
